context.completed_history: chronological delivered END list of {nominal_duration>0,duration>0}; optional start/end/delivered provenance ignored in features
context.elapsed: public current START age; exactly zero for STAGED; excludes dependency WAIT
context.nominal_duration: positive public original geometry duration; not previously predicted duration

entrypoint: from predictor import DurationPredictor; predict = DurationPredictor(model_path, mode); result = predict(context)

output.future_duration_ratio: unconditional duration expectation divided by original nominal duration
output.metadata: method, mu_log_duration, sigma, survival_probability, unconditional_mean; conditional modes only
output.remaining_time: conditional execution remaining mean; not safety bound or full path ETA

position_fusion: Root R19 adapter uses registered R18 linear_history overwrite for delivered current-occurrence POSITION. No remaining-segment scaling or claimed joint posterior. END-only arm isolates the model.
